prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a hit while turning left. The patient had 6 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1086; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- The patient was treated for the same body area within the last two years, and that condition adds to the current complaints.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a collision that occurred while the patient was turning left and was struck from the side. Initial evaluation documented pain, swelling, and reduced grip strength in the left wrist. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm a fracture of the distal radius. Six visits were completed over the course of care, including immobilization, follow-up imaging, and a structured rehabilitation program. Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved, with pain and range of motion steadily recovering. The patient was also treated for the same body area within the last two years, and that prior condition adds to the current complaints, so some of the symptoms reported today may reflect that earlier history. It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash, and causation remains under review pending additional records. Billing records show no repeated charges for the same services. The patient is being discharged from active care with a plan for home exercises and as-needed follow-up.
